action.mutates: creates the account p8testuser, turns on GDM's automatic login for it in /etc/gdm3/custom.conf (the original kept under /run/p8test-gnome and put back once the session runs), restarts gdm3 so the session starts, and waits for the session to lock (up to 120 s for the session, then up to 240 s)

outcomes.outcome: dconf-cli is installed and the dconf profile stacks the user database over the system database local
the system database sets idle-delay 300 (5 minutes), lock-enabled true and lock-delay 0, compiled by dconf update
a user cannot override the three locked keys, while a key the class does not lock stays writable
a GNOME session that goes idle locks after the idle time and the grace period, and sees the policy as not writable
